id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

physicalAssetEventCategoryRelation.description: Equipment-event category combination that this prediction is for

parent.description: The ML pipeline result that this prediction is based off of

predictedValueExceedsThresholdDate.description: "Most likely" predicted date. Represents when the main forecast crosses the threshold. If null, indicates that the main forecast never crosses the threshold

predictedLowerBoundExceedsThresholdDate.description: Represents when the lower bound forecast crosses the threshold. May be sooner or later than the `predictedValueExceedsThresholdDate` depending on the diagnostic of the forecast.

predictedUpperBoundExceedsThresholdDate.description: Represents when the upper bound forecast crosses the threshold. May be sooner or later than the `predictedValueExceedsThresholdDate` depending on the diagnostic of the forecast.

lowerBoundPredictedDate.description: Represents the lower bound of the range of predicted dates for the event, i.e. the earliest an event is predicted to happen, with 95% confidence.

upperBoundPredictedDate.description: Represents the upper bound of the range of predicted dates for the event, i.e. the latest an event is predicted to happen, with 95% confidence

numDaysToPredictedDate.description: Days until the predicted date when value exceeds threshold.

numDaysToPredictedDateLowerBound.description: Days until the predicted date when lower bound exceeds threshold.

numDaysToPredictedDateUpperBound.description: Days until the predicted date when upper bound exceeds threshold.

numDaysToPredictedDateFormatted.description: Days until the predicted date (formatted). The extra preceding spaces are to make this a sortable field, e.g. to make '  2 Days' come before '100 Days'.

title: Created by parsing a {@link TimeToEventForecastResult} and extracting the relevant information for UI purposes.
